contributions.statement: Do not use a read-only coding agent as the vulnerability gate for service endpoints; even when given the advisory, agents found the sink (critical operation) more often than the entry point (51% vs 30% file-level) and produced incomplete traces, so keep deterministic SAST as the gate and supply entry points explicitly when asking an agent to triage.
contributions.evidence: Table 3 oracle-conditioned analysis, 43 Hard items, 9 configs: CO FR max 51.16% vs EP FR 30.23%; max trace ES 36.37%. Table 2 end-to-end best 7/31 advisories. Single run, no execution allowed.
relative_to: LLM vulnerability detection is unreliable; keep SAST as gate (known)

reason: Mostly a benchmark, but the oracle-conditioned split locates the weakness at entry-point identification, which tells a team where agent security triage needs human or tool input; the scaffold-model sensitivity claim is noise-level.
